diagnosis: All four rollouts successfully revealed both PF1 (by A2) and PF2 (by A3) and cited both in justification_fact_ids, so disclosure and provenance were never the problem. The gate failed because checks C4 and C5 exhibit ENCODING MISMATCH: the facts were revealed and cited, yet the checks still failed in most rollouts due to overly specific commitment-type or wording requirements. C4 (linked to PF1) passed only in rollouts 2 and 3, where the settlement used commitment type "oxygen_arrangements"; it failed in rollout 0 (type "oxygen_continuity") and rollout 1 (no oxygen-specific commitment at all). C5 (linked to PF2) passed only in rollout 3, whose transport commitment explicitly included both "before 15:00 today" and "expires at 17:00 today" with "today" after both times; it failed in rollouts 0, 1, and 2 despite those rollouts also stating the 15:00 deadline in commitments and decisions.
fix_instructions: For C4 (linked to PF1): loosen the check to accept any commitment that establishes the SNF as the oxygen-equipment provider, regardless of commitment type label. Rollout 0 used type "oxygen_continuity" with detail "The SNF will provide compatible oxygen equipment" and rollout 1 folded oxygen into a "respiratory_therapy" commitment; both convey the same required information as the "oxygen_arrangements" type that C4 currently appears to require. Broaden C4 to match on commitment detail content (SNF providing/has oxygen equipment) rather than on a specific type field. For C5 (linked to PF2): loosen the check to accept any commitment or decision field that states the transport submission deadline as 15:00 today. Rollouts 0, 1, and 2 all set decisions.transport_submission_deadline to "15:00 today" and included 15:00 in their transport commitments, but C5 still failed—likely because it requires the 17:00 expiration to also appear in the same commitment with the exact word "today" appended. Broaden C5 to accept the transport_submission_deadline decision field or any commitment mentioning the 15:00 deadline, without requiring the 17:00 expiration to be co-located in the same commitment text.
